anchor: Which dim-witted pack beast carries loads as if it were a size larger than its body, and only kicks for about 4 damage?
Which pack creature has a mental score of just 2, a brawn score of 14, and only 11 health?
What 4th-level spell lets me sense the direction to a familiar being within 1,000 feet, blocked by any lead barrier?
If my friend was changed into a different shape by a transformation spell, can my tracking magic still find them?
Which towering whirling spirit of wind can hurl Medium foes 20 feet away with booming blows, yet can't be frozen in place or knocked down?
Is there a gusty creature that can slip through a gap just one inch wide and has ground speed of only 10 feet but flies at 90?
What's the cooldown on a tiny carved toy that turns into a winged lion-eagle for six hours when tossed up to 60 feet?
Can I send my summoned animal back into its small trinket form early by touching it and spending my special action, or if it gets badly hurt?
Which huge ancient sea beast can breathe both air and water, swims at 80 feet, and bites for 14 damage?
Is there a hulking prehistoric creature with 90 health, a mental score of 4, and surprisingly good stealth?
What 1st-level spell makes a 10-foot square of slippery goo that tips creatures over unless they pass a quick-reflex roll?
Which spell can make a patch of ground hard to cross for a minute, and does it make anyone who walks through it fall down?
What hand gear sets my brawn to 19 while I wear it, needs attunement, and does nothing if my brawn is already 19 or more?
Would wearing magic hand gear help someone whose brawn score is already 19 or higher without it?
What metal-reinforced body protection stops enemies' lucky, devastating strikes from doing extra harm to me?
Which uncommon heavy or medium body protection, not made of hide, is reinforced with the hardest known metal?
Which small flying creature bursts into a fire blast when slain and breathes a hot cloud that slows down those caught in it?
Can you name a small flier that makes attackers roll with a handicap and ignores flame and toxins?
Which 10-gold-piece kit of inks and pens lets me write fancy script that's hard to forge?
What tool kit weighing 5 pounds and based on nimbleness lets me make ink and magical spell scrolls?
Which huge fire-born genie gets an edge against magic and returns from death in 1d4 days if it dies off its home plane?
Would a fire spirit with a 30 percent chance of knowing a grand spell grant my wish if I'm a djinn-like being myself?
Which 4th-level magic surrounds me with nature sprites in a 10-foot ring, forcing a willpower roll and dealing 5d8 pure magical harm on a failure?
Can I, while a swirl of nature spirits surrounds me for up to 10 minutes, step away from an enemy as a quick extra move?
What legendary bottle can capture a being from another world by making it fail a DC 17 willpower roll, and then obeys me for an hour when released?
Can a knowledge-revealing spell tell me whether a sealed container holds a living thing, or only reveal what's inside by opening it?
At what character level does a wilderness hunter who casts magic first get six ready spells and two second-level magic slots?
Which level gives a nature-trained wilderness warrior nine ready spells, two third-level magic slots, and a skill mastery boost?
Which magic smashing weapon adds +3 to attacks and damage, returns to my palm after I toss it, and does 2d8 extra pure magical harm to giants?
Is there a magic smasher I can fling that reaches 20 feet normally and 60 at long range, usable only by stout, bearded folk or girdle-bonded users?
Which oversized flying beast senses nearby prey by echolocation out to 120 feet and bites for about 6 damage?
Is there a big winged animal that flies quickly at 60 feet, moves only 10 feet on the ground, and has a mental score of 2?
Can a high-level blast mage max out a damaging spell's damage once free, but suffer rising death-energy harm if reused before a long rest?
After I've already used my maxed-out damage trick once, how does the harm I take on each later use change before my next long rest?
Which silver chain with a black gem makes me immune to venom damage and to being sickened by toxins?
I'm exploring a swamp full of toxic creatures; what jewelry helps me avoid getting sick from their bites while I wear it?
Which huge chaotic good sky-titan hurls electric bolts from 500 feet away, shrugs off electric and booming harm, and controls the weather once a day?
Is there a flying, swimming, cold-resistant brute with 230 health and sight that sees through illusions, able to cast sense-magic at will?
Which 2nd-level trick lets me plant a message in an object that speaks in my voice when a condition, like a bell ringing nearby, happens?
Can a statue's face be made to repeat my 25-word note whenever someone walks within 30 feet, costing jade dust worth 10 gold?
At character level 18, what bard ability refills my song-based boosts up to two whenever I roll for turn order and I have fewer?
Which 1st-level charm lets me befriend a wild creature I can see for 24 hours, but it breaks if my side hurts that creature?
Is there a nature-charm that needs a tiny treat as a component, letting me befriend extra wild creatures as I use bigger slots?
What headwear lets me change my look with a spell while worn, and needs attunement?
If I pull off my cap, does the look-changing magic on it remain in effect?
What 5th-level mind-over-matter spell can shove a creature up to 30 feet, leaving it pinned and floating in the air if I lift it?
Can I yank an unattended item across a room up to 30 feet by will, but need a contest of raw might to snatch one from someone's hand?
If an enchanter has bewitched me, do they gain a social edge over me when they try to persuade or manage me?
Can I still attack the one who enthralled me, or hurl a harmful magic at them while I'm under their control?
At level 19, what extra feat does a frenzied fighter get to choose, with a recommended pick for hard-hitting offense?
Once a berserker hits its 19th level, can it take any feat it qualifies for instead of a special power boon?
Which small or medium humanoid gains a hit-chance edge when a buddy stands within 5 feet of the foe and fires a heavy launcher up to 400 feet?
What middling thug with 32 health and a brawn score of 15 swings a mace for 5 crushing damage on a hit?
Which small plant-creature with a weak 1-damage swipe is hurt extra by flame but resists stabbing attacks?
What woodland plant-person speaks an everyday tongue plus one more and barely threatens anyone, with only 10 health?
On my random magic stick's chart, which percentile roll range yields a dud that hurts my mind for 1d6?
On a percentile roll of 26-30 on my random magic stick's chart, what blast of air shoots from me toward the chosen spot?
Which 9th-level spell freezes everyone else's clocks so I get a few free turns, but it ends if I affect someone else or travel more than 1,000 feet?
Can a high-level mage pause the world for two to five personal turns while acting freely?
What rare magic stick holds 7 charges, letting me reshape a creature's form, and regains 1d6+1 charges each dawn?
When I burn the final charge on my shape-changing rod, what odds does it turn to ashes and vanish?
Which huge serpent-like monster is immune to electric harm, breathes a 90-foot line of electric bolts, and coils around a foe to restrain it?
Is there a huge creature with 168 health that is slow-witted, with a mental score of 7, and both walks and climbs at 50 feet?
What hand gear lets me use a quick response to cut arrow and bolt damage by 1d10 plus my nimbleness modifier, and catch the projectile if it's small?
Can magic hand gear let me catch a small thrown knife or arrow out of the air, provided I have a free hand and it fits?
Which 15-gold-piece kit lets me sketch a small area's layout, using insight-based skill, and weighs 6 pounds?
Which legendary holy amulet makes demons and undead take 8d6 holy-light harm on touch, and can open a crack that swallows a foe on a failed roll?
Does a cleric's pendant that doubles as a religious symbol boost my spell attacks by 2 while I hold it?
Which lawful evil large aberration with mind-to-mind speech can curse creatures in a 5-foot slime cloud so they can't heal outside water?
If a slimy water-dwelling brute is destroyed, does it come back in 5 to 50 days, possibly in a distant dimension?
Which nature-caster humanoid with 44 health makes two attacks, one a toxic staff strike and one a glowing orb hurled 90 feet?
Is there a nature mystic that can cast a plant-snaring spell twice a day and a thunder blast twice a day using Wisdom?
What rare pouch of dried legumes explodes in a 10-foot ball of pure magic harm when I dump them, dealing 5d4 damage on a failed nimbleness roll?
If I plant a dried legume and water it, what sudden effect might appear a minute later, chosen by the game master?
Which wearable mantle casts a fake image of me nearby so enemies' attacks are made at a penalty, but stops working until my next turn if I'm hurt?
Does a magic mantle that tricks foes into aiming poorly still work while I'm rooted to one spot with zero movement?
